name: Tirisfal Pumpkin
summary: At Solliden Farmstead, living humans still tend pumpkins in blighted Tirisfal. The Forsaken take them for the Royal Apothecary Society’s mixtures.

sections.title: Harvest in a Blighted Land
sections.body: West of Brill, crops still grow despite the corruption spreading across Lordaeron. At Solliden Farmstead, living human farmers work the soil and grow large orange pumpkins under the watch of the nearby Scarlet Crusade. The harvest feeds these farmers. To the Forsaken of Brill, the pumpkins are targets for sabotage and raw materials for Apothecary Johaan.

sections.title: Apothecary Reagents
sections.body: Deathguard Simmer sends young Forsaken into the contested fields to steal pumpkins from under the farmers’ noses. The vegetables do not feed the dead; they go into the Royal Apothecary Society’s cauldrons. Apothecaries test how natural plants react to plagues and experimental mixtures, using Lordaeron’s remaining crops against the living.

faq.q: Where can Tirisfal Pumpkins be found?
faq.answer: They grow at Solliden Farmstead, west of Brill and just north of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want these pumpkins?
faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer orders the pumpkins stolen to deny them to the surviving humans and the Scarlet Crusade, and to bring them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill as raw materials for apothecary research.

faq.q: Can players eat or cook with Tirisfal Pumpkins?
faq.answer: No. The Royal Apothecary Society gathers them for its mixtures, and adventurers do not use them for cooking.
Living human farmers still tend the soil at Solliden Farmstead, with loose protection from the Scarlet Crusade at a nearby watchtower.

angles.text: As an undead, you raid Solliden Farmstead both to deprive living people of food and to provide Apothecary Johaan with materials for Forsaken research.
As an Alliance member, you see the pumpkins at Solliden Farmstead as the surviving people of Lordaeron trying to feed themselves amid Forsaken raids.
